sources.title: Kanami Sensei no Nihongo: Beginners (Pre JLPT N5)
sources.en: Short, very slow talks in simple Japanese about daily life, made for absolute beginners; free transcripts on the teacher's site.
sources.tip: Listen once with no text, then read the free transcript and say each sentence aloud after her.
sources.notes: Reviewer opened Apple page 20 Nov 2026: by Kanami Sensei / Japademy Japanese Learning Inc., years active 2026, episodes from May 30 to Oct 30 (one on the 2026 World Cup), 6 to 13 min. Page says free transcripts on Japademy site and English subtitles throughout; cc left empty because the schema has no value for English-only subtitles. Paid courses are promoted but the show is free. ja dropped: the show writes its name as Kanami Sensei の Nihongo, no Japanese name in kanji.

sources.title: Kanami Sensei no Nihongo: JLPT N5
sources.en: Slow, clear N5-level talks about everyday life in Japan from a Japanese teacher, with free transcripts on her site.
sources.tip: Play one episode three times: first with no text, then with the transcript, then with no text again.
sources.notes: Reviewer opened Apple page 20 Nov 2026: Japademy Japanese Learning Inc. (c) 2026, episodes Jun 2 to Oct 2 incl. 2026 World Cup topic. Free transcripts on Japademy site; English subtitles stated, cc left empty (no schema value). Sister show of the Pre-N5 one, separate feed.

sources.title: Japanese with Shun
sources.en: Clear, slow Japanese-only episodes for beginners on everyday topics, with occasional special talks about learning.
sources.tip: Start with the episodes marked N5-N4 and replay one until you can follow it without the transcript.
sources.notes: Reviewer opened Apple page 20 Nov 2026: host Shunsuke Otani, years active 2021-2026, episodes Nov 13, Nov 6, Oct 23 and a special 6 days earlier. Transcript link goes to Patreon (free or paid not stated); paid courses promoted, so free+paid.

sources.title: Nihongo con Teppei (Japanese podcast for beginners)
sources.en: Short daily talks in Japanese only, told simply and with much repetition; good for building a daily listening habit.
sources.tip: Listen to one short episode a day; do not pause to look words up, just follow the story.
sources.notes: Reviewer opened Apple page 20 Nov 2026: host Teppei, updated daily, active 2019-2026, newest episodes 1 to 5 days old plus Nov 1-8. Description says content is kept free; donations via Patreon and Ko-fi. No transcripts mentioned. Level from title and reviews.

sources.title: Slow Japanese
sources.en: Short episodes by a Japanese speaker, spoken slowly, on customs, culture and daily life in Japan.
sources.tip: Pick one episode and write down five words you hear before you look them up.
sources.notes: Reviewer opened Apple page 20 Nov 2026: by Akari (Mochifika), years active 2021-2026, episodes Sep 28 to Nov 9 and one 4 days old. Page says A1 to B1/B2. Transcripts via Patreon; episodes 1-5 free on the show site. One episode is about the host's depression (personal story).

sources.title: NHK Easy-Language News (radio)
sources.ja: NHKやさしいことばニュース
sources.en: A short daily NHK radio news bulletin in plain Japanese, made for listeners who find everyday news hard to follow.
sources.tip: Listen to one bulletin twice, then read the same story on an easy-news site to check what you caught.
sources.notes: Added by reviewer. Found via WebSearch; opened Apple page 20 Nov 2026: NHK (Japan Broadcasting Corporation), years active 2026, updated daily, 5 episodes kept, dated 16 to 20 Nov 2026, 5 min each. Description: news with few technical words, for foreigners, older people, children and disabled people. No transcripts mentioned. Show site nhk.jp/p/rs/34PY344RPJ/ could not be opened (blocked). Level is reviewer judgement (plain wording, broadcast pace).

sources.title: Easy Japanese: Conversation Lessons (NHK WORLD-JAPAN)
sources.en: A finished beginner course from NHK WORLD-JAPAN following a student in Japan; each lesson teaches one useful phrase.
sources.tip: Do one lesson a day in order and repeat the key phrase aloud until you can say it without the audio.
sources.notes: Moved from unverified by reviewer. Opened Apple page 20 Nov 2026: NHK WORLD-JAPAN, 48 lessons of about 10 min, 2019-2020, marked free, still online. Explanation language not stated on the page; the course is the English edition, so ja+en is reviewer judgement from the listing being in English.

sources.title: Beppu Kurashi: Intermediate Japanese JLPT N3
sources.en: Short talks about life in Beppu and Oita that stick to N3 grammar and words, each with a Japanese summary in the notes.
sources.tip: Read the Japanese summary first, then listen and pick out the details it leaves out.
sources.notes: Reviewer opened Apple page 20 Nov 2026: creator Kieran Ebert, years active 2026, 11 episodes Mar 26 to Oct 19, 5 to 13 min. Host says he made it to improve his own speaking, so he is likely a learner, not a native speaker (main chat to decide). No transcripts, no price.

sources.title: Sayuri Saying: Everyday Japanese Podcast
sources.en: Natural talk about daily life and social customs in Japan for intermediate learners; transcripts are on the host's site.
sources.tip: Listen to the whole episode for the gist, then read the transcript and note the casual forms.
sources.notes: Reviewer opened Apple page 20 Nov 2026: Sayuri Saying, years active 2020-2026, episodes Aug 31 to Oct 12 and one 5 days old. Transcripts and video at sayurisaying.com; a paid membership for bonus content, so free+paid.

sources.title: Nihongo Thatsdan
sources.ja: にほんご ザッツ談《だん》
sources.en: Unscripted chats between a Japanese couple about daily life, with a Japanese transcript for every episode.
sources.tip: Read the transcript while you listen to see how spoken Japanese shortens and drops words.
sources.notes: Reviewer opened Apple page 20 Nov 2026: by Chiyoshi, years active 2019-2025, 224 episodes, last 20 Apr 2025; still online, so archive. Transcripts on note.com/nihongothatsdan. Description: for intermediate and advanced learners. No price shown.

sources.title: Advanced Japanese Podcast with SAYAS
sources.en: Long talks in natural Japanese on culture, society and wellbeing, for upper-intermediate and advanced learners.
sources.tip: Split a long episode into two sittings and keep a list of words for feelings and stress.
sources.notes: Reviewer opened Apple page 20 Nov 2026: SAYAS Japanese, years active 2024-2026, episodes Aug 21 to Nov 13 and one 5 hours old. Transcripts via Patreon, paid lessons promoted. One episode on burnout and perfectionism (personal view, not a health source).

sources.title: NHK Radio News
sources.en: Short NHK radio news bulletins in standard broadcast Japanese, posted through the day.
sources.tip: Listen to a 5-minute bulletin, then find one of its stories in text and compare.
sources.notes: Reviewer opened Apple page 20 Nov 2026: NHK (Japan Broadcasting Corporation), NHK Podcast channel, updated daily, years active 2010-2026; listed episodes dated 9 Nov 2026 (the page copy seen may be cached). No region limit stated. No transcripts.

sources.title: News School (Asahi Shimbun Podcast)
sources.ja: ニュースの 学校《がっこう》
sources.en: A daily Asahi Shimbun show that explains one news keyword in friendly conversation, each episode with a link to an article.
sources.tip: Pick a keyword you already know in English so the explanation is easier to follow.
sources.notes: Replaced podwise.ai link. Podnews gave Apple id 1551595534; reviewer opened that Apple page 20 Nov 2026: publisher Asahi Shimbun Podcast, host Daisuke Kanda, daily, episodes from Nov 10 to 20 hours old, 9 to 15 min. Asahi podcast site is asahi.com/special/podcasts/ (not opened).

sources.title: NIKKEI PrimeVOICE
sources.ja: 日経《にっけい》 プライムボイス
sources.en: A weekly business-news podcast where Nikkei editors explain one story each; formal, dense vocabulary.
sources.tip: Read a short English summary of the topic first, then listen for the key terms.
sources.notes: Reviewer opened Apple page (us and jp) 20 Nov 2026: NIKKEI PrimeVOICE (日経プライムボイス), Nikkei Inc., years active 2024-2026, episodes Sep 28 to Nov 10 and one 2 days old, 6 to 14 min. Episodes play without sign-in; Nikkei Prime membership is for the newspaper, not the podcast.

sources.title: Tonari no Zatsudan (TBS Radio)
sources.ja: となりの 雑談《ざつだん》
sources.en: A weekly unscripted chat between two TBS Radio hosts with no set theme, like overhearing friends in a cafe.
sources.tip: Do not try to catch every word; follow when the topic changes and how the hosts react.
sources.notes: Replaced podwise.ai link. Apple id from Podcast Republic search result; reviewer opened Apple page 20 Nov 2026: TBS RADIO / TBS Podcast, hosts Naoko Sakurabayashi and Jane Su, years active 2023-2026, EP.194 to EP.201 (Sep 29 to 3 days old, one titled autumn 26), 17 to 33 min. TBS own page tbsradio.jp/kikimimi was blocked.

sources.title: Scientalk
sources.en: A researcher and an illustrator talk about science history, researchers and science news in relaxed Japanese.
sources.tip: Choose an episode on a topic you already know; the background helps you follow.
sources.notes: Reviewer opened Apple page 20 Nov 2026: hosts Ren and EMMA, site scien-talk.com, years active 2021-2026, episodes Oct 28 to Nov 11 and one 1 day old. Listed also as Video, so cc unknown. Independent show; general science, not health.

sources.title: Doctor Salon (Radio NIKKEI)
sources.en: A Radio NIKKEI programme for clinicians in which specialist doctors answer questions from practising doctors.
sources.tip: Use it once your clinical vocabulary is solid; pick a topic from your own rotation and listen twice.
sources.notes: Own page radionikkei.jp/dr_salon/ opened 20 Nov 2026: Radio NIKKEI medical information programme for clinicians, sponsored by Kyorin Pharmaceutical; episodes go out as a podcast about a week after broadcast; no fee or registration mentioned (its schedule list shown was old, 2022). Apple page (id from Podnews) opened: Radio NIKKEI, 2019-2026, episodes Oct 27 to 1 day old; plays with no sign-in or price. URL set to Apple because it plays in a phone browser.
